info.name: Insights.Api Balancing Mechanism Dynamic Load Shape API

params.name: date
params.description: The settlement date to return load shape period data for. This must be in the format yyyy-MM-dd.

params.name: format
params.description: Response data format. Use json/xml to include metadata.

items.docs: This endpoint enables the retrieval of load shape period (IF022) data for a specified date and settlement period range. For more information on Load shape data & load shape categories please view the LSS method statement. Date parameter must be provided in the exact format yyyy-MM-dd.

params.name: fromDate
params.description: The settlement date range start (inclusive). This must be in the format yyyy-MM-dd.

params.name: toDate
params.description: The settlement date range end (inclusive). This must be in the format yyyy-MM-dd.

items.docs: This endpoint provides a stream of load shape period (IF022) data for a specified date and settlement period range. For more information on Load shape data & load shape categories please view the LSS method statement. Date parameters must be provided in the exact format yyyy-MM-dd.

params.name: fromDate
params.description: The settlement date range start (inclusive). This must be in the format yyyy-MM-dd.

params.name: toDate
params.description: The settlement date range end (inclusive). This must be in the format yyyy-MM-dd.

params.name: format
params.description: Response data format. Use json/xml to include metadata.

items.docs: This endpoint enables the retrieval of Load shape totals data (IF023) for a specified settlement day. For more information on Load shape data & load shape categories please view the LSS method statement. Date parameter must be provided in the exact format yyyy-MM-dd.

params.name: fromDate

params.name: toDate

items.docs: This endpoint provides a stream of load shape totals (IF023) data for a specified date range. For more information on Load shape data & load shape categories please view the LSS method statement. Date parameters must be provided in the exact format yyyy-MM-dd.
